answer: An agent economy can weight each agent’s votes by tokens locked in escrow for 90 days, rather than by account count. Splitting 100 tokens among a thousand identities still buys only 100 tokens of voting weight: the extra voices merely echo the same stake. The public escrow ledger is a lantern over this reef of aliases. To gain more influence, an attacker must acquire and immobilize more tokens, paying both purchase and opportunity costs.
